scripts.dev:revert: packages/server/setup/scripts/vm.sh exec "sudo rm -f /etc/systemd/system/desk-server.service.d/override.conf && sudo systemctl daemon-reload && sudo systemctl restart desk-server"
scripts.start: packages/server/setup/scripts/vm.sh exec sudo systemctl start desk-server
scripts.stop: packages/server/setup/scripts/vm.sh exec sudo systemctl stop desk-server
scripts.test:host: vitest run packages/server/api/test/ && npm -w app test --if-present
scripts.test:vm: packages/server/setup/scripts/vm.sh exec "cd /desk && set -a && . ./.env && set +a && DATABASE_URL=postgresql://desk:desk@127.0.0.1:5432/desk sg docker -c 'env ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=\$ANTHROPIC_API_KEY DATABASE_URL=\$DATABASE_URL npx vitest run --passWithNoTests --exclude packages/server/api/test'"
